messages:
maria_support: hey team — multiple customers reporting 5xx errors from the hosted inference API (~10:03 UTC). they see intermittent 502/504s and spike in latency. raising here to triage.

maria_support: example customer repro: curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'

--- response snippet ---
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"upstream error: control-plane returned 5xx"}
--- end ---

maria_support: tickets: TKT-4432, TKT-4438, TKT-4441. customers are seeing failures ~every 2-3 minutes across regions us-west/us-east.

tom_sre: thanks, adding SRE. any recent deploys? can you paste the root request id from the customer response headers (x-rw-request-id)?

maria_support: request ids: rw-req-0a1b2c, rw-req-0a1b9f, rw-req-0a1bff. also attaching truncated control-plane error from edge logs: 

[logs]
2026-03-15T10:02:43Z ctrlplane auth-session-service => 504 gateway timeout (connect to config-db timed out) req=rw-req-0a1b2c
2026-03-15T10:02:44Z ctrlplane routing-policy => 502 upstream error (policy-resolver timed out) req=rw-req-0a1b9f
2026-03-15T10:02:46Z ctrlplane session-service => 500 fatal (sessionstore read error: timeout) req=rw-req-0a1bff

maria_support: customers report sharp increase in errors starting ~10:00 UTC, correlates with a control-plane deploy at 09:58 UTC per deploy logs.

deploy-bot: @here deploy completed: control-plane v3.12.1 at 09:58 UTC by aleks_eng. CI: passed.

jess_prod: noted. initial read: two potential things — (1) auth/session dependency to config DB is timing out under transient load, (2) routing-policy service is slow resolving policies, causing gateway 502 to downstream inference nodes. both returning 5xx back to API.

aleks_eng: pulling logs now. i see a burst of DB connection errors on the config-db pool at ~09:59-10:04 UTC. stack traces show connection timeouts from the session-store client after the deploy.

aleks_eng: snippet from ctrlplane session-service:
```
ERR [session-store] connect timeout to config-db: dial tcp 10.2.33.7:5432: i/o timeout
stack: session_store.go:142 session_handler.go:88
```

aleks_eng: routing-policy service is also timing out on policy-resolver RPCs to config service (same DB-backed store).

tom_sre: hypothesis: the v3.12.1 deploy changed a DB migration/connection pool default or introduced a heavier policy warmup path. quick repro: can someone run the following locally against staging?
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <test-token>' https://staging-api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -v
```

jess_prod: I can repro on staging, getting 504s to ctrlplane auth-session-service. adding tracing: trace id stg-77a.

maria_support: affected customers list in support queue: acme-inc, midwest-saas, large-payments. all flagged high priority. notifying acme now with ETA.

support-bot: Created escalation E-789 to Eng SRE, pager duty notified.

tom_sre: mitigation options: 1) rollback control-plane to v3.12.0 (safe) 2) increase config-db connection pool and backoff in session-service 3) add short-term retry at API gateway for control-plane 5xx. prefer rollback if we confirm deploy is the cause.

aleks_eng: agree — safe rollback is fastest. prepping rollback; canary still reporting errors so full rollback ok.

jess_prod: while rollback executes, we should also add an immediate tweak: patch session-service to use conservative DB connect timeout (e.g., 3s -> 6s) and increase pool max by 20%. I'll open a hotfix PR if rollback stalls.

aleks_eng: rollback started at 10:12 UTC. monitor dashboards.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for control-plane to v3.12.0 by aleks_eng at 10:12 UTC.

maria_support: letting customers know we're rolling back. will update tickets.

[~10:16 UTC]

tom_sre: metrics: error-rate dropped from 18% -> 4% over 4 minutes after rollback. latency back to normal baseline for most customers.

jess_prod: confirmed staging hotfix still needed for root cause (DB pool/migration edge-case), but rollback mitigated immediate customer impact. opening follow-up ticket for durable fix.

maria_support: customer notifications sent. three customers confirmed restored; one still saw retries but eventually success.

support-bot: Follow-up task created: TASK-1023 "investigate config-db connection saturation & session-store defaults" assigned to aleks_eng, jess_prod. due 2026-03-18.

tom_sre: postmortem checklist: - include timeline - attach logs for rw-req-* - trace data - how deploy changed DB defaults - plan for canary improvements and automated rollback on 5xx spike. assign owners.

aleks_eng: i'll own the root cause investigation and the PR to adjust pool defaults and add a guarded migration check.

jess_prod: i'll add a regression test that simulates policy-warmup under limited DB connections and ensure throttling/backoff is present.

maria_support: thanks all — closing this thread once TASK-1023 is in motion. customers updated. :thankyou: 

tom_sre: adding final note: make sure to update runbooks for control-plane deploys to include quick DB-pool sanity checks and metric thresholds (connections in use, p99 connect latency).

maria_support: noted, we'll add that to the runbook.

maria_support: resolved for now — will re-open if symptoms reappear.
